notes: TMR Queensland design sheet (Q-series book / TC-series), colour drawing 'not to scale' with a lettered dimension table; every dimension from the sheet, AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheets give no letter widths, so there is no width check. Q-series sheet W7-Q01_2 railway level crossing short-stacking warning sign 'KEEP TRACK CLEAR' (cross road beyond the crossing; 2023, page 2 of 7), fully dimensioned and drawn to scale, 1200 x 1100, R100. Upper part: yellow ground, yellow edge 10 + black border 10 (the sheet's 10 / 20); lower part from 870 down: red with a white band 10 wide 10 in from the edge along the sides and bottom (the sheet's vectors), white legend 90 Series D. Right chain 75 / 770 / 25 / 55 / 90D / 85 = 1100: legend cap top(s) [925]; word gaps [44, 58] measured. DISAGREEMENT: the sheet labels the overall height 900 but its chain and drawing give 1100; 1100 generated. Layout symbol (road, track, stacking arrows): the sheet PDF's own vector artwork (tools/symbols/qld_w7-q01-2_layout.svg), placed as drawn: 785.0 x 770.0 at x 207.5, y 75.0 (the sheet's chain dimensions describe this artwork). Distance: numeral 100 Series D in the dashed box (159 wide at x 214) and 'm' Series E modified lower case 33 after it ('65Em' is the height of the lower-case m itself, drawn 64.8: cap height 86.67), baseline 555, as drawn ('insert appropriate distance in metres e.g. 20'): 20 and 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 generated (the owner: the variants that make sense, not every value). Black, red and white on retroreflective yellow.
